map.输入样本数据（或样本均值、标准差与样本量），在总体标准差未知时，用样本 t 分布: Enter the sample data (or the sample mean, standard deviation and sample size); when the population standard deviation is unknown, use the sample t distribution to test whether the sample mean differs significantly from the hypothesized population mean, outputting the t statistic, degrees of freedom and p value for small-sample mean hypothesis tests.
map.填写「样本标准差 s」。: Enter the sample standard deviation s.
map.检验样本均值是否等于已知值：t=(x̄−m0)/(s/√n)。: Test whether the sample mean equals a known value: t = (x_mean - m0)/(s/sqrt(n)).
map.df=n−1，小样本用 t 分布。: df = n-1; use the t distribution for small samples.
map.判断偏离是否有统计意义。: Judge whether the deviation has statistical meaning.
map.：x̄=105、m0=100、s=15、n=25：t=5/(15/5)=5/3≈: With x_mean=105, m0=100, s=15, n=25: t = 5/(15/5) = 5/3 = about 1.667, df=24. The critical t(0.05, 24) is about 2.064, so it is not significant (p about 0.108).
map.：x̄=112：t=12/3=4.0，远超临界，显著（p<0.001）。: With x_mean=112: t = 12/3 = 4.0, well above the critical value and significant (p<0.001).
map.σ 未知用样本 s 估计，小样本下 s 波动使 t 分布更胖尾，比 z 保守。: When sigma is unknown it is estimated with the sample s, and at small n the fluctuation of s makes the t distribution have heavier tails, so t is more conservative than z.
map.p 值怎么得？: How do you get a p value?
map.由 t 与 df 查 t 分布，双尾 p=2×P(T>|t|)；本工具内置 er: Look up the t distribution from t and df, with two-tailed p = 2 x P(T>|t|); this tool has erf/betai built in.
